content: Introduction: a. Begin your presentation by introducing yourself and providing a brief
overview of your research topic. b. Clearly state the objectives and goals of your research
to set the context for your presentation

(quantitative
qualitative
mixed methods

research objectives. c. Discuss any data collection techniques
tools

chapters.chapter_name: Discussion: a. Interpret and discuss your research findings in the context of your research
content: objectives and literature review. b. Analyze any patterns
trends
or relationships observed
in your data. c. Address any limitations or challenges encountered during your research and
discuss their impact on the results
